title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 9.0 security update
description: .NET 9.0 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux contains an elevation of privilege vulnerability in ASP.NET Core identified as CVE-2026-114148. This security issue affects multiple .NET versions including 8.0, 9.0, 10.0, and 11.0. Red Hat has released security updates for these versions as part of their Extended Update Support for RHEL 10.0. The vulnerability allows an attacker to gain elevated privileges, potentially compromising system security.
